written_by: setup fixer, round 0, for audit finding F1 (audits/setup/determinism-cost-context-r0.md)
supersedes: facts/setup.json determinism.tie_noise_example guidance ('use several seeds to measure tie noise')
CONTRACT 'Noise, determinism, gates': noise floor from identical re-runs of (policy, cell, repeat)
why: Replay is deterministic per (policy, workload, policy seed). Identical re-runs of rr, lmetric, two-tier, seeded default (and learned-choice at temperature 0) have zero spread, so a repeat-sd floor is false. The arbitrary order of simultaneous arrivals (Mooncake/toolagent: 3 s bursts, 113 distinct timestamps in the 2000-row slice) moves per-cell goodput by 1.2-3.9% CV for every policy (measured below).

protocol.implementation: WT/benchmarks/learned_routing/learned_routing/replicates.py and noise.py, commit <commit-02>; tests in WT/benchmarks/learned_routing/tests/test_replicates.py (11 pass)
protocol.repeat_semantics: lr-eval --repeats K evaluates replicates k = 0..K-1. Replicate k of a cell = materialize_replicate(cell's materialized trace, trace_format, k) (a seeded permutation of arbitrary arrival order, identical for every policy on that trace) + policy seed k+1. Every k, including 0, is permuted; the recorded file order is not used.
protocol.replicate_seed: int(sha256('crn-order-v1|<source trace sha256>|<k>')[:8]) >> 1; depends on trace content and k only, so cells sharing a trace (other N, other load level) share replicate workloads (CRN across N and levels too)

per_format.mooncake: sessions (a single-turn row is a one-row session) sharing a first-arrival timestamp are permuted; turns stay in order within a session; arrival times unchanged; rows with wait_for are rejected
per_format.weka: the trace is re-materialized as a play-per-line JSONL in loader order and the play order is permuted (agentic lanes take plays in source order). Dir vs identity-order JSONL replay identically except label ids (runs/setup-fix-r0/out/weka_identity_check.json)
per_format.synthetic_sessions: no file; pass arrival_seed = synthetic_arrival_seed(sha256 of canonical synthetic spec, k)

protocol.policy_seed: k + 1, injected as parameters.seed into every policy type that accepts seed (dynamo-default-cost-fn, learned-choice, sticky-session if seeded). The seed is NOT part of policy_sha; record it as its own field.
protocol.cache_key: sha256(canonical policy YAML without seed) + cell_id + harness_version + 'crn-order-v1' + k. The contract's key (policy YAML + cell_id + harness_version) would return replicate 0 for every k of an unseeded policy and silently restore the zero-spread floor.
protocol.degenerate: If a trace has no permutable units (no arrival ties, fewer than 2 plays), PermutationStats.degenerate is true and its replicates are identical except for policy seed; lr-eval must flag replicate_degenerate and the noise for that cell must come from workload segments, never from these replicates.
protocol.never: Never estimate noise, thresholds, or gate conditions from identical re-runs (same workload, same seed).

rules.paired_ratio: r[c][k] = goodput(policy, c, k) / goodput(default@defaults, c, k), the default run on the same replicate k (same workload, seed k+1). noise.paired_ratios asserts both sides cover the same (cell, k) set.
rules.pooled_sd: sqrt(mean over cells of the sample variance over k of r[c][k]) (noise.pooled_sd); requires >= 2 replicates per cell
rules.differs_beyond_noise: clause 1: some validation cell has |mean_k r[c][k] - 1| > 3 x pooled_sd; clause 2: cells are averaged within independent workload segments (same trace window / play subset / synthetic spec), then |mean over segments| > 2 x SE over segments, with >= 3 segments; degenerate (pooled_sd == 0) never passes. Implemented by noise.differs_beyond_noise.
rules.cma_es: within a generation every candidate and the default reference use the same (cell, k) set (CRN); rotate k across generations through a fixed pool and normalize each candidate by default on the same k (LR-03)

measured_setup_fix_r0.label: uncalibrated smoke cells (setup's 2000-row Mooncake slice, SLA TTFT 2000 ms / ITL 50 ms; AgentX 2-play sample); calibration must re-measure per family and N
observations: Every replicate was itself deterministic: rerunning replicate 0 reproduced the full per-request hash for every policy and cell.
Original-order goodput at mc2000-n8-open reproduces setup and the auditor exactly (default seed1 2.868672871547336, lmetric 3.153759121853308, rr 2.890342652363542).

The recorded file order is not a typical draw for round-robin: rr/default original-order ratio is 1.0076 at mc2000-n8-open, below all 8 replicates (1.0195-1.0655), and 0.8320 at mc2000-n8-closed32, below the replicate mean 0.8591 (range 0.8174-0.9021). This is why k = 0 is permuted too. Mechanism not established [hypothesis: file order groups related prefixes within a burst].

Open loop: the spread is in the good count (good_frac CV ~ goodput CV; makespan CV 0.2-1.1%). Closed loop: mostly in makespan (good_frac CV 0.45-0.86%, duration CV 0.7-2.0%), which LR-01's arrival-window denominator would change.
One trace segment cannot certify a difference: on the three Mooncake cells (one segment) clause 1 holds for lmetric, rr and two-tier but clause 2 cannot (segments = 1).

calibration_todo: Re-measure per family x N (at least one cell per family at each of N in {4, 8} and one of {2, 16, 32}) with K = 8 replicates, on calibrated loads and SLAs; record pooled paired-ratio sd per (family, N, load mode) here or in facts/noise_calibration.json; size validation segments and K from it (LR-02 power check n ~ 8/(delta/s)^2).
